title: China’s AI research is booming: what it’s like to be on the front line
title_zh: 中国的AI研究正蓬勃发展：身处一线的真实感受
abstract: China trains more AI talent than any other country. Nature spoke to analysts and scientists about how AI research there compares to the United States.
abstract_zh: 中国训练的AI人才比任何其他国家都多。Nature 采访了分析人士和科学家，探讨了中国的AI研究与美国的对比。
